fields.description: The key a rate names, the gateway counts under, and a Usage Record carries: lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
fields.label: Counter

fields.description: Column header in the Usage Record form.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: What a rate is quoted per: USD per million tokens, or USD per request (a search, a call). Set on a root counter; a derived one takes its base's.
fields.label: Unit

fields.description: The counter this one is carved out of. The container's rate charges what its parts left of it. Root counters only.
fields.label: Part Of

fields.description: Set on a derived counter: the root it splits off from, whose rate it bills at when the pricing holds none of its own.
fields.label: Base Counter

fields.description: A request whose whole prompt exceeds this many tokens is counted under this counter instead of its base.
fields.label: Prompt Above (tokens)
